questions.question: On this day in 1558, which Tudor royal acceded to the thrones of England and Ireland following the death of Mary I?
questions.explanation: Elizabeth I inherited the English and Irish crowns on 17 November 1558, launching a celebrated 44-year reign that defined the Elizabethan era.
questions.context:
On this day in 1558: Elizabeth I (pictured) became Queen of England and of Ireland, marking the beginning of the Elizabethan era.
Elizabeth I (Queen of England and Ireland from 1558 to 1603): Elizabeth I was Queen of England and Ireland from 17 November 1558 until her death in 1603. She was the last and longest reigning monarch of the House of Tudor. Her eventful reign, and its effect on history and culture, gave name to the Elizabethan era.

questions.question: Which English actor concluded his five-film run as secret agent James Bond with the 2021 release 'No Time to Die'?
questions.explanation: Daniel Craig portrayed the iconic British spy in five films between 2006 and 2021, beginning with Casino Royale.
questions.context: Daniel Craig (English actor (born 1968)): Daniel Wroughton Craig is an English actor. He gained international fame by playing the fictional secret agent James Bond in the films Casino Royale (2006), Quantum of Solace (2008), Skyfall (2012), Spectre (2015) and No Time to Die (2021).

questions.question: Which English indie rock band is fronted by Ricky Wilson, who also served as a winning coach on 'The Voice UK'?
questions.explanation: Ricky Wilson leads the Leeds-formed five-piece rock band Kaiser Chiefs and achieved back-to-back coaching victories on The Voice UK.
questions.context: Ricky Wilson (singer) (English musician, painter and media personality (born 1978)): Charles Richard Wilson is an English musician and the frontman of five-piece rock band Kaiser Chiefs. In September 2013, Wilson was confirmed as a coach on The Voice UK. He was the winning coach for both the fourth and fifth series of the show, being the first coach to win two years consecutively. Wilson left the show after three series, following the show's move to ITV.

questions.question: Which Spanish master created the haunting work 'Saturn Devouring His Son' directly upon the walls of his residence?
questions.explanation: Painted between roughly 1820 and 1823 as one of Francisco Goya's famous Black Paintings, the artwork was later transferred to canvas and hung in Madrid's Museo del Prado.
questions.context: Saturn Devouring His Son (Painting by Francisco Goya (c. 1820–1823)): Saturn Devouring His Son is a painting by Spanish artist Francisco Goya. The work is one of the 14 so-called Black Paintings that Goya painted directly on the walls of his house some time between 1820 and 1823. It was transferred to canvas after Goya's death and is now in the Museo del Prado in Madrid.

questions.question: Under which continental body does the Palestine national football team compete in international tournaments?
questions.explanation: Under the worldwide umbrella of FIFA, Palestine competes at the regional continental level within the Asian Football Confederation (AFC).
questions.context: Palestine national football team (Men's association football team): The Palestine national football team, governed by the Palestinian Football Association, represents Palestine in men's international football. The team is under the global jurisdiction of FIFA and is governed continentally by the Asian Football Confederation (AFC).
